name: Jira Epic Outcome View
description: Group a Jira project's work by Epic and show, for each Epic, what it delivered beside what that work was meant to change. The delivery half is composed from the flow-metrics skill's own per-issue rows -- counts only, never a recomputed duration and never a percentile. The outcome half is read from the Epic description's Outcome block; where none is recorded the view says so and asks the team for one. Read-only: no Jira write verb, and neither the working directory tree nor the installed pack tree changes across a run.

deps._runtime_contract: Sibling skills are addressed BY NAME at runtime. The agent's harness resolves the name to whatever install location the user picked. `source` below is install guidance only -- never a runtime path.

skills.name: jira
skills.purpose: Every Jira read: the field catalogue lookup that locates the flagged field, the paginated search that supplies the Epic set, each issue's parent link and each issue's state, and the per-issue change history that says when a flag was last raised. Read verbs and `raw GET` only; no transition, comment, attachment, create, update or delete.

skills.name: flow-metrics
skills.purpose: The delivery reading, run exactly once in per-issue mode with the cache inert. Its rows are grouped and counted here; no metric it defines is recomputed. The inert cache mode is the only mode this view composes through, because the plain bypass flag still unlinks stale temporary files from a cache directory relative to the working directory.

deps._pip_rationale: No deps.pip entry: stdlib only. Every per-Epic figure is a count, so no numeric stack is needed.

input.arguments: Required: --project KEY. Optional: --from YYYY-MM-DD / --to YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive window bounds, default: the last 90 days ending today UTC); --include-subtasks (count delivered subtasks in throughput, as flow-metrics does under the same flag); --jql "<expr>" (extra JQL narrowing the flow reading's scope).

env.JIRA_EPIC_OUTCOME_VIEW_JIRA_SCRIPT: Optional path to the jira skill's script, when it is not installed beside this skill.
env.JIRA_EPIC_OUTCOME_VIEW_FLOW_METRICS_SCRI: Optional path to the flow-metrics skill's scripts directory, when it is not installed beside this skill.

artifacts: stdout: one JSON document carrying the project, the window, the moment of the flow reading, the moment of the Jira read, the browse-permission disclosure, and one entry per Epic.

No file is left anywhere. The per-issue file flow-metrics requires is written to a scratch directory outside both the invocation working directory tree and the installed pack tree, and is removed before this process returns -- including when the run fails.
